card.fact_statement: BNP leader Azizul Haque led a group that attacked a Hindu household in Dhamrai Upazila.
card.source_span: A group of 100–150 people, led by BNP leader Azizul Haque, attacked a Hindu household in Dhamrai Upazila.

target_qa_variants.question: 在2024年孟加拉国反印度教暴力事件期间，哪位孟加拉国民族主义党领导人带领一群人袭击了达姆拉伊乌帕齐拉的一户印度教家庭？
target_qa_variants.source_span: A group of 100–150 people, led by BNP leader Azizul Haque, attacked a Hindu household in Dhamrai Upazila.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: BNP is translated as 孟加拉国民族主义党, Dhamrai Upazila as 达姆拉伊乌帕齐拉, and Azizul Haque as 阿齐祖尔·哈克.

backtranslation_en.question: During the 2024 anti-Hindu violence in Bangladesh, which Bangladesh Nationalist Party leader led a group of people to attack a Hindu family in Dhamrai Upazila?
